title: コンピュータシステム基礎
subtitle: Fundamentals of Computer Systems
educationalGoal:
Students will:
(1) Learn how to store information as “binary data” on computer systems.
(2) Learn logic circuits to understand the behavior of computer systems.
(3) Learn the basic mechanism of processing “machine code” inside computer systems.
advice:
Learn the fundamentals of the configuration and behavior of program-stored computers for base systems of AI and IoT. Understand the function of instructions and concrete operation of computers through circuit design exercises.

1. Basic structure of a computer
2. data representation and codes
3. logic circuits
4. Main memory and address
5. CPU and instruction execution
6. Instruction Cycle
7. Machine language instructions and assembly language
8. Program Processing
books:
Textbooks：Introduction to Computers: Introduction to Information Systems, 9th Edition (in Japanese)
Reference books：Introduction to Logic Circuits (in Japanese)
Reserved books：None
requiredKnowledge:
No prior knowledge is required, but the self-motivated learning attitude is essential as follows:
1. Listen carefully to each lecture, organize any questions you have, and resolve them by asking the teachers or your friends.
2. Input circuits yourself in exercises using a logic circuit simulator, execute them, and verify the results.
3. Try solving the exercise problems in the lecture before looking at the answers, Create your own example problems and solve them.

activityGoals.body: Be able to convert and compute base 2-decimal numbers, to explain the coding of information.
Be able to explain the role of each device in a computer.
Be able to explain basic instruction execution.
Be able to explain the operation of circuits composed of logic gate elements (AND, OR, NOT, etc.).
Be able to explain the operation of encoders, decoders, and multiplexers.
Be able to construct an n-bit addition circuit using fulladders.
